summary: Frontend-only testing for the new Demonstration Lab at /demonstrations. Executed 52 checks across content, testids, media placeholders, navigation (desktop + mobile 390px), TMMS cross-link, regression of forbidden terms across 6 pages, and axe-core 4.10.2 WCAG scan. All 52 checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Task description contained placeholder-like testid strings (e.g. 'demo-lab-sim-label-jovial-goodall-9', 'walkthrough-item-demo-jovial-goodall-9', 'demo-lab-open-jovial-goodall-9'). Actual (and correct) implementation uses per-slug testids: 'demo-lab-sim-label-{factory|warehouse|hotel|hospital}', 'walkthrough-item-demo-{slug}', 'demo-lab-open-{slug}'. Verified all four per-slug variants exist and behave correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demonstration Lab shipped at /demonstrations. Nav includes 'Demonstrations' (data-testid=nav-demonstrations, aria-current=page when active) and mobile-nav-demonstrations at 390px. Four sector blocks (factory, warehouse, hotel, hospital) with per-slug testids. Hospital carries 'Future target sector' tag. Each block renders walkthrough-item-demo-{slug} containing walkthrough-placeholder (no <video>, no file input) because REACT_APP_PREVIEW_MEDIA=true and no approved recordings. Preview-only notice visible (demo-lab-preview-notice). /tmms shows tmms-demo-lab-link 'Visit the Demonstration Lab'. axe-core 4.10.2 (wcag2a/aa,wcag21a/aa,wcag22aa) => 0 violations on /demonstrations. No forbidden terms on /, /tmms, /demonstrations, /about, /insights/what-is-a-cmms, /insights/reactive-vs-preventive-maintenance.
